name: chomp
description: Read the user's Chomp chats and memories, and message or start Chomp chats. Asks for the Chomp address and an outside-agent token when enabled.

url.title: Chomp MCP URL
url.description: Where Chomp answers outside agents, e.g. https://chomp.example.com/api/outside-mcp

token.title: Chomp outside-agent token
token.description: The value of an AGENT_TOKEN_<NAME> secret in Chomp's Settings. <NAME> is how your messages are labelled
